evals.prompt: Add 10 more prospects to my Cullman Pipeline. I've got plenty of auto shops already, so focus on trades that get emergency calls.
evals.expected_output: About 10 new independent emergency-call trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, towing) not already in the tracker, each with a phone confirmed on its own website or two listings that agree, starter-led plans, four-paragraph notes; written in one batch and confirmed by readback; a short report with a table, left-out reasons and sources. Towing counts as an emergency trade. No repair or body shops, no franchises, nobody contacted.
